about: Cross-language vectors of suggest (DESIGN.md D100): a port gives these brands and models, in this order. Brand ids number the brands from 1 in the order of their search keys, model ids the models from 1 in the order of their search keys inside a brand.

catalog.model: A B C D E F G H I J K

prefer.about: suggest with a hint (DESIGN.md D106): the brands named in prefer go first where the rules do not tell entries apart, and nowhere else. A case asks `main`, the catalog and aliases above, or `ties`, the catalog and aliases of this section, which has more ties for a hint to break; ids number brands and models as for the catalog above. A port that gives the answers of `suggest` need not read this section.
